output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is zero, the 'balances[msg.sender] -= _value' statement will cause a integer overflow and set balances[msg.sender] to a large value, also known as 'negative token distribution' attack.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is zero, the 'balances[_to] += _value' statement will cause a integer overflow and set balances[_to] to a large value, also known as 'negative token distribution' attack.
